payload.entry: Public interfaces for planner-contract: RecordCatalog::new(vault_root) + folder(dir) lazily indexes one folder's immediate Markdown files through the closing frontmatter delimiter (missing folders stay empty and are never created). FolderIndex exposes notes(), lookup_stem (case-insensitive Exact/Ambiguous/None, original spelling/path), nearest_stems/nearest_values (bounded_levenshtein distance 2, top 3), value_suggestions (collapse by case-folded wikilink alias or target stem, insert most-frequent original, count a record once, rank frequency then recency then path), and colliding_path(stem, reserved) for on-disk plus caller-planned paths. IndexedRecord keeps raw Scalar/List/Null fields and MissingTitle/InvalidYaml/NoteRead diagnostics so a bad YAML or missing title still collides. Athena release 500-note evidence: cold=4.35ms, warm-cached=120ns, 5 warm-FS samples 3.11–3.87ms (under 10ms). Two consumers share one read; unrelated folders are not opened.

payload.entry:
LANDING REVIEW at 86af3d5e (origin/master fetched and identical): read this epic, all four child beads and every note, plan:202611/records_engine.md, binding plan:202611/record_notes.md, parent phase bob-cli-ir.2 and outer DECISIONS. Reviewed cd8a031f (schema/fixtures), 93c7c114 (render/update), b9db7007 (catalog), a8ccf5ed (planner/docs) and the actual modules/tests. The 107-title fixture, four raw fixtures, config isolation, typed validators, lazy catalog and timing evidence are present. The claimed update safety and complete planner contract are not yet satisfied; keep this epic and bob-cli-ir.2 open pending a medium tale repair.
FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: the only PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP is bob-cli-ir.2.1.3 note #1 (schema.rs clippy derivable_impls and needless_borrows_for_generic_args), repeated in its close note. Declined a separate task: it was caused by this epic, and b9db7007 already derived RecordsConfig::Default and removed the needless mapping.get borrow. No genuinely distinct unrelated proposal remains, so no new task or corroboration is needed. Carry this outcome into the eventual close note.
INTEGRATION: reviewed all five non-epic commits after cd8a031f: 984f8196 signed-start diagnostics, 126958b2 mail display contracts, 23217c1d close typing aliases, b4147b0b Gmail hold/lift, 86af3d5e Gmail watch preparation. The engine has no capture or Gmail callers yet; their domain-specific behavior should not be routed through records. Shared docs registry/nav/snapshot already compose mail order 43 and records order 44 (44 entries). No integration edit needed at this base. Both epic-symbol inventories (bob-cli-ir.2.1 and bob-cli-ir.2) are empty; no just symvision recipe exists at review time.
BLOCKERS: catalog markdown_stem panics on one/two-byte non-Markdown filenames due to eager then_some slicing; folder enumeration hides occupied .md paths for external symlinks/nonregular entries and planner treats folder-read diagnostics as nonblocking; catalog list extraction drops null/unsupported members. Render span parsing treats nested keys as top-level and does not decode escaped YAML keys, accepts root flow/nonmapping YAML before inserting fields, checks required-empty only after finding a span, unconditionally adds EOF newline, and its heading scan ignores only triple-backtick fences. Planner lacks stem source, agreed set/default/missing/invalid/none states, optional supplied ranges, unknown-field nearest/allowed-key structured context, and resolves dynamic defaults only for display/render rather than the returned value. docs/records.md has no update-preservation section. Repair within the existing engine contract, with actual API regressions and just check/docs-check, then finish nested landing in the same coder turn.
EVIDENCE: file:explicit:0463132eb6eafca3abae823e contains a compiled probe of verbatim std-only production functions: short-name panics, nested status span, escaped key mismatch, and tilde-fence heading misclassification. This is focused source evidence, not a full engine test run. No just check or check-full was run by this landing review.

LANDING BLOCKER at origin/master 9e0bcdd81aa8f39b4d0559df440a839e38fd582d. Implementation repairs are complete; this workspace was rebased from 86af3d5e after a non-overlapping Gmail sync commit landed. Focused cargo test --lib native::records:: passes (64 passed, 1 ignored); just docs-gen and just docs-check passed. Required sase tool run check ToolRun 4dbaae8977c2e80294c41a26c9844e73 fails: eight denied clippy::collapsible_if findings in the new Gmail sync files src/native/gmail/sync/file.rs (lines 1117, 1961, 2116) and src/native/gmail/sync/watch_apply.rs (591, 600, 613, 625, 633). The one records test needless-borrow lint was fixed and the focused records suite rerun successfully. These upstream Gmail changes are outside the records tale scope; keep this epic open until the required check is green. Therefore the approved landing sequence cannot close bob-cli-ir.2.1 or mark plan:202611/records_engine.md done yet. Empty epic-symbol inventory; no symvision recipe. FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: child bob-cli-ir.2.1.3 note number 1 schema clippy proposal remains resolved by b9db7007; no duplicate task was filed. No unrelated proposal from this tale.

LANDED at origin/master 5ef66125 plus lander edits. VERIFIED: re-read this epic, all four phases and every note, plan:202611/records_engine.md and its landing tale 202611/records_engine_landing.md (status done). Read 8ff0d8ed against every blocker in landing note #1: catalog markdown_stem no longer slices eagerly (short names/dirs safe); .md dirs and outside symlinks stay as occupants that collide; unreadable/non-dir/escaping folders set create_refusal -> FolderUnavailable; IndexedField keeps lossless raw_value and Unsupported members never rank; render update scans root keys only, decodes quoted keys (sta\u0074us dup refused), refuses flow/nonmapping roots, checks required-empty even when absent, keeps missing EOF newlines, and uses shared markdown fence helpers (tilde/longer fences tested); planner returns set/default/missing/invalid/none states, stem_source, resolved dynamic defaults, unknown-field suggestions plus allowed_keys, optional source_ranges; docs/records.md has Updating notes. Frozen 107-title fixture, four raw notes, config isolation tests, and the ignored 500-note timing test are present. LANDER EDITS: mapped RecordPlanErrorCode::ExplicitStemRequired to record_title (plan: empty normalized titles use record_title; outer design: a title yielding an empty stem needs record_title) with a test assertion; documented the module-wide dead_code allowance in records/mod.rs as awaiting bob-cli-ir.3/bob-cli-ir.5 consumers. CHECKS: just check EXIT=0 before and after edits (lib 5824 passed, 3 ignored; all binaries ok); records suite 64 passed/1 ignored; config suite 169 passed; just lint clean of denied lints. just docs-check fails only on mounted bob-mac-capture word budgets (capture-panel 6088, keyboard 6060, protocol 6014) introduced by bob-cli-iu.2 commit e7ddfc6; with the mount pinned to 2a39c2f via BOB_DOCS_BOB_MAC_CAPTURE_DIR, docs-check passes all gates. INTEGRATION: reviewed non-epic commits 9e0bcdd8, 457153f0, 5a63e9a2, b252669b, 25c02232 (cleared the prior Gmail collapsible_if blocker), 0b8b913f, 5ef66125; none touches records or duplicates its frontmatter/stem logic, so no integration edit. FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: bob-cli-ir.2.1.3 note #1 schema clippy proposal declined (epic-caused, already fixed by b9db7007). Docs budget failure recorded as DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic bob-cli-iu (causal: e7ddfc6); no new task; not a +1 on bob-cli-h9, whose 8e2ecd7 overage was trimmed to 5995 before e7ddfc6. epic-symbols empty; no symvision recipe.
